parole.significato: to fiddle, fidget with (something); to touch (something) lightly and repeatedly with one's fingers
parole.testo: Probably of onomatopoeic origin; from the same stem as babirkál (“to fritter, tinker”) + -ál (frequentative verb-forming suffix). The stem may also be related to the stem of bibe, bibi and bíbelődik. Possibly developed under the influence of Slovak babrať (“to fiddle with”), from Proto-Slavic *babra

parole.significato: stack, rick (a large, rectangular-based pile of hay, grain, straw)
a merchant of domestic animals (particularly horses, cattle, or pigs)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Slovak kupec (“merchant, trader”), from Proto-Slavic *kupьcь (compare Czech kupec (“merchant, trader”), Serbo-Croatian kúpac (“buyer”), Russian купе́ц (kupéc, “merchant; buyer”)).
Probably from Slovak lavica (“bench”), from Proto-Slavic *lava (“bench”).
